comment: R4 baseline for `idl-regress --old git:v1.4.19 --new self --lang csharp` against the FULL main-tests corpus. v1.4.19's C# backend (`CSharpImports.scala:80 withImport`) throws `scala.NotImplementedError` on post-v1.4.19 type shapes — same version-gap class as the Scala and TS legs. HEAD handles them cleanly. Future R4 reruns must observe the same build-failure-old-side mode (exit=2, same NotImplementedError site) — any change is an explicit signal requiring operator re-baseline. Note: the C# adapter has a pre-existing canonicalize defect under `dotnet run` (SYSLIB0014 deprecation warnings leak onto stdout and confuse the NDJSON parser) which would surface even if the v1.4.19 build succeeded; tracked as F-followup-csharp-dotnet-stdout-stderr-split.
